question: Where’s the closest restaurant along the travel direction toward West Chester Cardiology, West Chester, PA?
sql: WITH pa_state_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Pennsylvania%' AND border_type = 'state' LIMIT 1 ), west_chester_city_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%West Chester%' AND border_type = 'city' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pa_state_geom)::geography) LIMIT 1 ), start_point AS ( -- Calculate the centroid of West Chester city as the starting point SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM west_chester_city_geom ), target_poi AS ( -- Find the geometry of West Chester Cardiology SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%West Chester Cardiology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%West Chester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_corridor AS ( -- Create a line from the start point to the target POI, buffer it by 500 meters to define the "travel direction" corridor SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geom, tp.geom::geometry)::geography, 500) AS geom FROM start_point sp, target_poi tp ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- Ensure the restaurant is within the defined travel corridor AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM travel_corridor)::geography) -- Ensure the restaurant is also within the West Chester city boundaries AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM west_chester_city_geom)::geography) ORDER BY -- Order by distance to West Chester Cardiology to find the closest one within the corridor p.geometry <-> (SELECT geom FROM target_poi) LIMIT 1;
